steps: Equip your starting axe from the inventory.
Walk up to any tree and hold the attack button until it falls.
You must kill every unique NPC type, including town NPCs.
Use lava traps or direct attacks during a Blood Moon for easier NPC kills.
Track which NPCs you've defeated — there is no in-game tracker for this.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Clothier counts — don't forget to summon and kill Skeletron first so the Clothier NPC spawns.
Reddit tip: Santa Claus only appears during the in-game Christmas season (Dec 15-31). Plan ahead.
warnings: Some NPCs only spawn under specific conditions — make sure all are available before starting.
